about_the_game:
Steamboard is the free & open-source app that help you securely get and visualize your steam revenues with pretty dashboards.

How does it work?

Install

Run our standalone application from your computer, your data stays local, nothing is send to the cloud.

Connect

Enter your Steam Financial API key, which is encrypted and safely stored on your computer.

Sync & export

Steamboard regularly syncs with Steam to download your latest sales data, delivering valuable insights.

Features

  • Own your sales data: Once sales are synced, everything stays privately on your computer. Nothing is shared with our company or the cloud.

  • Auto sync: Continuously synchronize your sales from Steam to keep your revenues up-to-date.

  • Dashboard: Track your weekly, monthly, yearly units sold or gross/net revenues.

  • 3D world map: Visualize your sales on a 3D map, highlighting each country based on revenue.

  • Copy to clipboard: Copy your sales data into your clipboard, to be easily pasted in your existing spreadsheet.

  • Export to CSV: Generate and export consistent CSV files, ready to be used in your workflow.

  • Open source: Steamboard is fully open-source, ensuring transparency, reliability and trustworthiness.

The application is build using Tauri, Deno, Vuejs and the official Steamworks API.
